title: Design: a part cost of zero shows dashes in every column
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, one range from $0.00 with Default on Margin % 40.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Replace the Part Cost with 0.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • The simulator reads $ 100 with prices under every column.

Step 3:

  • Every simulator column shows a single "—" and no profit line.
  • The Part Cost box shows its error state, as in picture 5.3.
